shortDescription: Set boot options like boot, kickstart image and issu.

options.name: issu
options.description: Upgrade using In Service Software Upgrade (ISSU). (Supported on N5k, N7k, N9k platforms) Selecting 'required' or 'yes' means that upgrades will only proceed if the switch is capable of ISSU. Selecting 'desired' means that upgrades will use ISSU if possible but will fall back to disruptive upgrade if needed. Selecting 'no' means do not use ISSU. Forced disruptive.

options.name: kickstart_image_file
options.description: Name of the kickstart image file on flash. (Not required on all Nexus platforms)

options.name: system_image_file
options.description: Name of the system (or combined) image file on flash.
